$INSTAR is live on pump.fun.

7HVsxJsGrcako6PbRof7R2JoUb6Tbzmrz9B5NjwaNQVv

What it does: its creator fees are claimed by the world every ten minutes and paid into the cage, half to metabolism (how many flies can live), half to the pool (what the living flies earn). Every claim and every fund is a public transaction on the World account.

What it does not do: no governance, no access, no share of any fly. The cage runs with or without it. instarcage.com/coin.html
